repaired_parse.question: is my Indigo flight from Delhi to Jaipur at 6:40 or 8:15? I've lost the email
repaired_parse.gold:
@q query
  select ?v
  where match
    relation "be at"
    role subject "my Indigo flight from Delhi to Jaipur"
    role time ?v
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare any
    ?v equal "6:40"
    ?v equal "8:15"
  end

    role subject "the Indigo"
    role destination "Delhi"
    polarity affirmed
  end

    role subject "the Indigo"
    role object "Jaipur"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?price between 6:40 and 8:15

repaired_parse.question: If the invoice is paid 45 days late and statutory interest is 8% a year, what's the interest on £22,500?

  var ?x int 0 1000000000
  require 36500 times ?x at_most 22500 times 8 times 45
  require 36500 times ?x above 22500 times 8 times 45 minus 36500
  claim ?x at_least 0
  task possible
  select ?x
